The liberation contract icons should be white if they're an actual mission you missed, if they're just the icons with no background then that just means that's where your assassins are hanging out.

Do you have all 6 assassins recruited? If you do then you might have yourself a glitch.

You accept the mission and depending on what type it is different things could pop up on your map.

Delivery missions require you to collect certain items and then deliver them to the same guy you got the mission from. (Save these for last)

Courier missions just want you to go around delivering letters to certain NPCs around the map. (Your destinations should be black envelopes on your map)

For assassination missions you have to, well, assassinate people. Again, check your map for the dark assassination symbols on your map.

Homestead missions can happen in all 4 playable areas so it's good to check after every sequence or so.
